E1.evidence:
Issue #440 quotes the ROS 2 CI failure of QosRclcppTestFixture__rmw_cyclonedds_cpp.test_best_available_policies_publisher (test_best_available.cpp:128, "Expected equality of these values:
  publishers_info.size()
    Which is: 0
  1u") and gives a patch that makes it fail reliably (a 10 ms dds_sleepfor in handle_builtintopic_endpoint for "rt/test_best_available_publisher"); maintainers (eboasson, clalancette) confirmed the cause.

E2.evidence: The test (package test_quality_of_service in ros2/system_tests) creates a publisher and immediately queries the graph through rclcpp -> rcl -> rmw_get_publishers_info_by_topic, assuming the just-created publisher is already listed; rmw_cyclonedds_cpp fills its graph cache from a discovery thread, so the query can return an empty list. The failure depends on this timing/consistency assumption between the two units (with a middleware that updates the graph synchronously the assertion holds), and the resolution added the missing statement to the declared rmw API (rmw PR #352) as well as changing the consumer. Not deployment wiring, build, or firmware.

E3.evidence: PAIR: rmw_cyclonedds_cpp's output (the publishers info list returned for the topic) feeds the test's input (its QoS assertions).

E4.evidence: Observed CI failure: `publishers_info.size()` "Which is: 0" where 1 was expected (https://github.com/ros2/rmw_cyclonedds/issues/440).

units.name: test_quality_of_service
units.revision_basis: The failure was reported from ROS 2 CI (ci_linux build 18164) on rolling around 2023-03-06; the job's exact revisions are not quoted in the issue. 010c34ba is the rolling head of ros2/system_tests on the report date (committed 2023-02-13) and is also the parent of the fix commit. The issue links test_best_available.cpp at c21d78c8f3386a6081578303439c1c04d5433e29; the diff c21d78c8..010c34ba touches only CHANGELOG, CMakeLists and package.xml files, so the test source is identical. Resolved revision 6313065486c6 is the single-parent commit on rolling from merging PR #513 (2023-04-04), which wraps get_publishers_info_by_topic / get_subscriptions_info_by_topic in a 5 s wait_for retry.

units.name: rmw_cyclonedds_cpp
units.revision_basis: Not stated by the reporter; c11d8cf4 is the rolling head of ros2/rmw_cyclonedds on the report date (committed 2023-02-14). The issue's analysis links rmw_node.cpp at 4bec4c8c5c9a7bf7187a2681dc57b1d9395dce0e (2023-01-17), an earlier rolling commit; the graph-cache update path cited there is the behaviour at issue. The resolution does not change rmw_cyclonedds, so the broken revision is kept.

failed_conditions.quote: However, what we do next is suspicious.  In line 120, we call `publisher->toggle()`, which is the first time that we are instantiating the underlying `rclcpp::Publisher`.  And then we are immediately calling `publisher->get_publishers_info_by_topic()`, which doesn't wait around at all; it just returns what it has right now.  So we have not given discovery any time to happen, and update the graph cache (which is what we are looking at here).

loudness_evidence:
The middleware returns an empty list without any diagnostic; the wrong answer is caught only by the test's own assertion: "test_best_available.cpp:128
Expected equality of these values:
  publishers_info.size()
    Which is: 0
  1u
    Which is: 1" (https://github.com/ros2/rmw_cyclonedds/issues/440).

resolution.summary: Consumer side: system_tests PR #513 (merged as 6313065486c6db146356b63e63c52b0c1e844f13) adds a wait_for helper and retries get_publishers_info_by_topic / get_subscriptions_info_by_topic for up to 5 s until exactly one endpoint is listed. Declared interface: rmw PR #352 (merged 2023-04-03 as bb044d59df89fac9fed8706aa58a8d7092fa31a2) adds to rmw_get_publishers_info_by_topic: "Depending on the RMW in use, discovery may be asynchronous.  Therefore, creating a publisher and then calling this API may not show the newly created publisher immediately." (and the analogous note for subscriptions). rmw_cyclonedds is unchanged.
resolution.evidence: PR #513 lists ROS 2 CI runs (ci_linux 18374 and 18410, aarch64, Windows) as status badges only; the text does not state their outcome for this test or the revisions of rmw_cyclonedds used, so the resolved composition is not shown working with both units identified by revision.

notes: Class `other`: the mismatch is a consistency/timing assumption (the test assumes the graph query reflects a publisher created immediately before on the same thread; rmw_cyclonedds updates its graph cache asynchronously from its discovery thread); no listed class names this. The test reaches rmw_cyclonedds through rclcpp::Node::get_publishers_info_by_topic -> rcl_get_publishers_info_by_topic -> rmw_get_publishers_info_by_topic (and rcl_wait_for_subscribers -> rmw_count_subscribers); inventory entries use the rmw symbols, which are the elements rmw_cyclonedds provides. The declared rmw contract lives in ros2/rmw (resolved bb044d59), which is not one of the two unit repositories. Maintainers also discussed a provider-side alternative (processing built-in topic data or synchronising with the discovery thread inside rmw_get_publishers_info_by_topic, eboasson) that was not implemented. The reporter's first analysis attributed the race to data_readers_ and data_writers_ being updated separately after rcl_wait_for_subscribers; the maintainer's later analysis (quoted) places it on the newly created publisher not yet being discovered; both concern the same element.
